title: indigo_mount_synscan: expose X_MOUNT_STEP_POSITION for both axes
description:
Add a read-only numeric property X_MOUNT_STEP_POSITION to the SynScan mount device, with RA and DEC items. Publish the motor step counters from the existing :j reads for both axes in the position poll, with no additional controller commands. Define the property for connected SynScan mounts whether or not they advertise auxiliary encoders, including the Sky-Watcher Wave 100i over USB. Keep X_MOUNT_ENCODER_POSITION and its :d behavior as they are.

Publish both axes from the same successful poll. If either read fails, keep the last valid pair and report ALERT until both reads succeed again. Document the counter units and reference convention so clients can convert counts to axis angles. The intended use is to read the mechanical RA axis position for a scheduler collision check, including at Home.
